subject: rt-algn
title: RT.ALGN.------CULT.INFO.DY.
description: Diagram in The New York Movement section (NYM-11): the reality alignment (RT-ALGN) of post-Ayler creative black music — with the (c) prefix, the concept of reality alignment — is *crossed* with culture information dynamics (CULT-INFO-DY). Besides the main line to CULT-INFO-DY, two lines leave the subject. One runs to TR-TRS (a diagram-only term), from which hang isolated focus (IST-F) and social reality particulars (SOC-RT-P). The other runs to political dynamics (POL-DYM) → political policies (POL-P); from POL-P branch controlled information (CN-INFO) → redocumentation (RE-DOC) → affinity compression (AF-COMP), and alternative functionalism (ALT-F) → information dissemination (INFO-DS). The page's prose makes the diagram concrete: rock music's commercial dominance was crushing post-Ayler musicians economically, but Braxton's claim is structural rather than circumstantial — by the time rock appeared, black creativity 'had already been systematically defined by the controlling forces from the white community and discarded' (NYM-12).
